results.content:
The Center Square Voters' Voice Poll found 20% of registered voters named inflation or price increases as the single most important issue facing the country, and 41% ranked it among their top three, more than any other issue on both measures.

Inflation has topped the list since March, when 16% named it their top concern, rising to 20% in June and holding there in August. As a top-three issue, concern eased slightly from 43% in June. [...] (The Center Square) – Inflation remains the issue American voters rank as most important heading into the midterms, with prices topping their list of concerns for a third consecutive poll, a new national poll finds.
